subject.title: fix: doctor clears legacy sandbox workspace state

question: Which active implementation should own the sandbox-copy Doctor recovery for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/111661: this narrower branch or the proof-positive alternative at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111791?
rationale: Both branches target the same canonical bug, but their discovery coverage and proof quality differ; choosing one is a maintainer ownership decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt the proof-positive alternative
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111791 because its reported probe demonstrates the full detect-migrate-delete-gate-clear sequence and its tests cover shared and custom roots.

options.title: Keep this narrower branch
options.body: Retain this implementation only after it adds equivalent redacted real recovery proof and maintainers confirm its scoped discovery is the intended long-term boundary.

options.title: Consolidate before landing
options.body: Ask one contributor to incorporate the selected coverage and proof into a single canonical PR, then close the duplicate candidate.

recommendation.title: Adopt the proof-positive alternative
recommendation.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111791 because its reported probe demonstrates the full detect-migrate-delete-gate-clear sequence and its tests cover shared and custom roots.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to the competing proof-positive implementation and can help compare concrete discovery coverage, though current-main ownership was not established from the available history.
